questions.q: what did monkey come out of?

answer_evidence.quote: "He's on the Fruit and Flower Mountain, down on Earth. There had been a rock on the mountain. The monkey came from the rock. The light shone from the monkey's eyes."

questions.q: what did the captain have?

answer_evidence.quote: But the captain had magical sight.

questions.q: who did monkey become friends with?

answer_evidence.quote: He became friends with all the other monkeys and apes.

questions.q: what did the monkeys and apes want to find?
questions.q_zh: 猴子和猿类想要找到什么？

answer_evidence.quote: "Why don't we follow the stream to find its source?"

questions.q: what will happen if monkey can jump through the waterfall?
questions.q_zh: 如果猴子能跳过瀑布，会发生什么？

answer_evidence.quote: "Whoever can jump through and come back alive will be our king," said a gibbon.

questions.q: what did monkey find in the cave?
questions.q_zh: 猴子在洞里找到了什么？

answer_evidence.quote: Deeper in the cave, Monkey found bedrooms with cozy beds.

questions.q: what did the monkeys do in the cave?

answer_evidence.quote: Some of the monkeys and apes began fighting and arguing.
They grabbed plates and bowls from one another.
Others fought over the bedrooms.

assistant_review.rationale: 洞内明确发生争抢、打斗；“玩游戏”发生在后来白天的森林和溪流，不是此处洞内事件，原文也没有说他们砸坏一切。

questions.q: why did everyone bow to monkey?
questions.q_zh: 为什么大家都向猴子鞠躬？
choices: he was really big and scary.

answer_evidence.quote: "I found this cave for us," said Monkey.
"That means I am now your king. Why aren't you bowing to me?"
He bowed to Monkey and said, "All hail the Monkey King."
Everyone else bowed too.

assistant_review.rationale: 猴子以自己为大家找到洞穴为由要求被奉为大王，长臂猿随后带头跪拜；故事没有给钱情节，也没有把体型巨大或可怕作为跪拜原因。

questions.q: why was monkey sad?

answer_evidence.quote: Monkey sighed. "Our life here is perfect."
Then he said, "Someday our lives will end. I wish this perfect life could last forever."
"Oh," he said. "You want to live forever?"
"I do," said Monkey.

assistant_review.rationale: 猴子因生命终会结束、希望美好生活永远延续而难过；宴席上食物充足，他也已有大量猴群朋友，因此缺食物和想要更多朋友都不成立。

questions.q: what are sages?

answer_evidence.quote: "Then you must study with a sage. Sages are very wise people. They can turn themselves into other animals. They can fly through the sky. And they know how to live forever."

questions.q: which is not true?
choices: monkey wanted to learn how to live forever.
choices_zh: 猴子从伐木工那里学到了东西。
猴子找到了须菩提的寺庙。

answer_evidence.quote: "And I want to live forever. Do you know where I can find a sage?"
"A sage named Subodhi lives on this mountain. He is very wise."
"Just follow this trail, and you will come to his home," said the woodcutter.
Soon he saw a temple built into the side of the mountain.

assistant_review.rationale: 樵夫只告诉猴子须菩提的位置和路线，并未教他本领；猴子明确想长生且随后找到了须菩提的山中寺院，所以 B、C 都是真，A 是不正确项。

questions.q: what was monkey looking for in the mountains?

answer_evidence.quote: "Hello," said Monkey. "Are there any sages in these mountains?"
"And I want to live forever. Do you know where I can find a sage?"
"A sage named Subodhi lives on this mountain. He is very wise."

assistant_review.rationale: 猴子主动询问山里是否有圣贤，并说明自己寻找圣贤以求长生；樵夫只是途中遇到的人，石头则是他的出生来源而非寻找目标。

questions.q: what did monkey want to be?

answer_evidence.quote: "And I want to live forever. Do you know where I can find a sage?"

questions.q: why did wukong start to dance?
choices: he knew how to live forever.
choices_zh: 他喜欢从菩提祖师那里学习。
他收到了一个秘密信息。

answer_evidence.quote: One day, while Subodhi was giving a lesson, Wukong started to dance.

questions.q: how did subodhi give wukong a secret message?
questions.q_zh: 苏婆地是如何给悟空一个秘密信息的？
choices: he knocked wukong on the head.

answer_evidence.quote: Subodhi became angry.
He stood up and knocked Wukong on the head three times.
Wukong, however, smiled.
None of the other students knew it, but Subodhi had given him a secret message.

assistant_review.rationale: 须菩提敲悟空头三下后离开，悟空由此识破秘密讯息；他没有耳语这条讯息，也没有递送信件。

questions.q: how did wukong learn to live forever?
questions.q_zh: 悟空是如何学会永生的？
choices: subodhi whispered formulas into his ear.
subodhi turned himself into a tree.
choices_zh: 苏波迪在他耳边低声念着口诀。
苏波迪把自己变成了一棵树。

answer_evidence.quote: Subodhi smiled. "I knew you were a worthy student. Come closer."
Subodhi whispered into Wukong's ear.
The sage whispered prayers as well as secret formulas about the universe and nature.
Now Wukong knew how to live forever!

assistant_review.rationale: 须菩提让悟空靠近并在耳边低声传授祷文和宇宙、自然的秘密口诀，悟空因此懂得长生；须菩提没有变成树，悟空也不是自学。

questions.q: what did wukong do while the other students slept?
questions.q_zh: 当其他学生睡觉时，悟空做了什么？

answer_evidence.quote: For the next few years, Wukong meditated and practiced the secret formulas.
While the other students slept at night, Wukong stayed up.
"I've been meditating and practicing secret formulas," said Wukong.

assistant_review.rationale: 原文明确说其他学生睡觉时悟空仍醒着冥想并练习秘密口诀；没有阅读古书情节，“强力练习”也不是文中所述活动。

questions.q: what did wukong show the other students he could do?
questions.q_zh: 悟空向其他学生展示了他能做什么？

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong smiled. "He taught me how to live forever. He also taught me how to change into other things."
He muttered a quick spell and made a sign with his hands.
Suddenly—zap! The monkey was gone.
An enormous pine tree stood in his place.

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空应学生要求施法，现场变成一棵巨大的松树；他虽会驾云和变动物，但这次展示既不是驾云，也不是变鸟。

questions.q: why did wukong have to leave?

answer_evidence.quote: "I taught you the secret formulas so you could live forever," said the sage.
"Not so you could show off!"
"Now all of the students have seen what you can do. They will want to know how to do it too! If you don't tell them, they might harm you. It's not safe for you to stay here anymore. You must go."
"Go back home," said Subodhi.

assistant_review.rationale: 其他学生看到秘密法术后可能逼迫或伤害悟空，须菩提明确说留下已不安全并命他离开；“学完一切”未被陈述，回家只是离开后的去向而非必须离开的原因。

questions.q: where did wukong arrive?

answer_evidence.quote: After a short journey, Wukong arrived at the Fruit and Flower Mountain.

questions.q: why did wukong go after the demon?
questions.q_zh: 悟空为什么要去追那个妖怪？
choices: to show how powerful he is
to be friends with the demon

answer_evidence.quote: "A demon attacked us," said the gibbon.
"We tried to fight him, but he was too powerful. He stole most of our things and kidnapped many of us."
Wukong was furious.
"Wait here," Wukong ordered. "I will handle the demon."

assistant_review.rationale: 恶魔袭击并绑架猴群后，悟空愤怒地决定亲自处理恶魔，目的是救回被绑架者并保护臣民；炫耀力量只是他的自信表达，与恶魔交朋友从未发生。

questions.q: where did the demon live?
choices: a cave on a gloomy mountain

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong soon spotted a gloomy mountain.
Dark clouds hung over it.
"That looks like a demon's home," he thought.
Wukong landed on the mountain and found a cave.

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空在北方找到笼罩乌云的阴沉山峰，并在山上发现恶魔洞穴；花果山是悟空的家，故事中不存在“云宫”这个恶魔住处。

questions.q: what did the demon ask his guards to bring?
questions.q_zh: 恶魔让他的守卫带来什么？

answer_evidence.quote: The Demon of Chaos was sitting at a table, eating a meal.
The demon stood up.
"Does the monkey have any weapons?"
"No," said one guard.
"Then get me my armor and my sword," said the demon.

assistant_review.rationale: 恶魔询问悟空是否有武器后，命守卫取来自己的盔甲和剑；饭菜已经在桌上，假猴子则后来由悟空的毛变化而成。

questions.q: what did wukong use to destroy the demon?
questions.q_zh: 悟空用什么来消灭那个妖怪？

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong pulled out a handful of his own hair and blew on it.
Poof! Each strand of hair turned into a fake monkey—exactly like Wukong.
All at once the fake monkeys attacked the demon, punching and kicking him.
"It's a magic spell," said Wukong.
"It's called Body Beyond the Body."
The Demon of Chaos was soon destroyed.

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空使用“身外身”法术把毛变成假猴群围攻恶魔，恶魔随后被消灭；剑属于恶魔，长矛只在后来训练猴群时出现。

questions.q: what did wukong teach his subjects?
choices: how to fight with swords and spears
choices_zh: 如何使用剑和矛进行战斗

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong spent the day teaching his subjects how to fight.

questions.q: who needed a powerful weapon?
questions.q_zh: 谁需要一件强大的武器？

answer_evidence.quote: "What's wrong with our swords and spears?" asked the gibbon.
"They're fine for normal monkeys and apes," said Wukong.
"But I am very powerful. I need a much heavier weapon."
"I need a heavy weapon because I'm as strong as a god. I want one of yours."

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空明确说普通刀枪不适合自己，需要更重的武器；龙王只是提供武器，龙后也没有提出自己需要武器。

questions.q: where did the dragon king live?
choices: the bottom of the eastern sea

answer_evidence.quote: "A dragon king lives at the bottom of the Eastern Sea," he said.

questions.q: why were the sword and spear not good for wukong?
questions.q_zh: 为什么剑和矛对悟空不好？

answer_evidence.quote: He soon came back, slowly dragging a huge sword.
Wukong picked up the sword with no trouble at all.
"This sword is too light," said Wukong.
A few minutes later, several turtles and octopuses dragged an enormous spear into the room.
Wukong lifted the spear and began stabbing at the air.
"This spear is too light."

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空先后举起巨剑和巨矛，都明确评价为太轻；它们不是太重，也没有任何木制描述。

questions.q: what did the queen want?
choices: she wanted wukong out of the palace.
she wanted to measure the oceans.

answer_evidence.quote: "This monkey is rude," the Dragon Queen whispered to her husband.
"Let's find him something quickly so he'll leave."
"What about the magical iron bar in the treasury? I'm sure that's heavy enough."
"I just want this monkey out of my palace!"

assistant_review.rationale: 龙后建议拿出铁棒的真实目的，是尽快让悟空离开宫殿；她本人不需要重武器，测量江河海洋是铁柱过去的用途。

questions.q: what did the king not say about the pillar?
questions.q_zh: 国王没有说过关于那根柱子什么？
choices: it was small and easy to handle.
it would be wukong's if he could lift it.
it was used to measure the oceans and rivers.
choices_zh: 如果他能举起它，那就是悟空的了。
它被用来测量海洋和河流。

answer_evidence.quote: "It's too heavy for anyone to lift. But if you can lift it, we'll let you have it."
An enormous iron pillar stood in the center of the room.
"That pillar was used to measure all the oceans and rivers," said the Dragon King.
"If you can pick it up, you can have it."

assistant_review.rationale: 龙王说铁柱重得无人能举、能举起就归悟空，并说明其曾测量江河海洋；原文反而称其“enormous”，所以“小且易拿”是唯一没说且被直接反驳的选项。

questions.q: how was wukong able to lift the pillar?
questions.q_zh: 悟空是如何能抬起那根柱子的？

answer_evidence.quote: "Hmm," he thought. "This piece of iron really is magical. I bet it will do whatever I want it to do."
"Smaller!" commanded Wukong.
The pillar shrank!
Soon it was just a little taller than Wukong.
He picked it up and swung it around.

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空判断铁柱会听命，命令它缩小后才将其举起挥舞；没有他人帮忙，“非常强壮”不是故事给出的这次成功机制。

questions.q: what were the monkeys amazed by?
questions.q_zh: 猴子们对什么感到惊讶？

answer_evidence.quote: Back home, the others were amazed by Wukong's new weapon.

questions.q: where did the spirits take wukong?
questions.q_zh: 灵魂把悟空带到哪里去了？
choices: to the judge of the dead

answer_evidence.quote: But as he fell asleep, two spirits grabbed him.
He kicked and struggled as the spirits dragged him out of his cave.
They walked toward a dark and creepy city.
A sign on the entrance gate said "Land of Darkness."
Wukong stomped into the Land of Darkness.
He headed toward the Palace of Darkness.
"I am the Judge of the Dead," said the spirit.

assistant_review.rationale: 两名鬼差把悟空拖往幽冥界，他进入幽冥宫后见到判官；玉帝和龙王都不是这两名鬼差带他去见的人。

questions.q: when do people go to the land of darkness?
questions.q_zh: 人们什么时候去黑暗之地？

answer_evidence.quote: "That's where people go when they die. I'm supposed to live forever!"

questions.q: why did wukong cross out names in the directory?
questions.q_zh: 悟空为什么要在名录中划掉名字？

answer_evidence.quote: "The Directory isn't wrong," said the judge.

questions.q: who did not come to see the jade emperor?
questions.q_zh: 谁没有来拜见玉皇大帝？

answer_evidence.quote: "The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea is here to see you."
The Dragon King entered and bowed.
"The Judge of the Dead would like to speak with you, Your Majesty."
The judge came in and bowed.
"A monkey named Sun Wukong crossed out his name in the Directory. I beg you to punish him!"

assistant_review.rationale: 东海龙王和幽冥判官先后进入天庭拜见玉帝并控诉悟空；混世魔王此前已被消灭，未在本集来见玉帝，因此 A 为否定题答案。

questions.q: why did the jade emperor want to punish wukong?
questions.q_zh: 玉皇为什么要惩罚悟空？
choices: he took his job very seriously.
choices_zh: 他对他的工作非常认真。

answer_evidence.quote: "A monkey named Sun Wukong crossed out his name in the Directory. I beg you to punish him!"
The Jade Emperor rubbed his chin.
"Who is this Sun Wukong? And how did he become so powerful?"
"I don't care how powerful he is. He is causing too much trouble on Earth. Gather some troops, and go down to the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I want Sun Wukong arrested!"

assistant_review.rationale: 判官控诉后，玉帝明确说自己不在乎悟空多强，而是因为他在人间惹了太多麻烦才要逮捕；“工作认真”是悟空后来管理桃园的表现，不是惩罚原因。

questions.q: why did wukong's subjects cheer for him?
questions.q_zh: 为什么悟空的臣民为他欢呼？
choices: he was invited to live in heaven.

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong was telling his subjects about his adventure in the Land of Darkness.
"After I crossed out my name," he said, "I crossed out all of your names too. We will all live forever!"
The monkeys and apes cheered.
"Hooray for the Monkey King!"

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空告诉臣民自己也划掉了他们的名字、大家都会长生，猴群随即欢呼；天庭邀请发生在欢呼之后，原文也未把“变强”写成这次欢呼原因。

questions.q: what was wukong put in charge of?

answer_evidence.quote: "Invite Wukong to come to live in Heaven. He will be in charge of the Royal Peach Garden."
"I'm putting you in charge of the Royal Peach Garden. You will have a home here in Heaven. I hope you won't cause any more trouble."

questions.q: how long does it take the peaches to become ripe?

answer_evidence.quote: The next morning a gardener showed Wukong the peach garden.
Bright, glowing peaches hung from every branch.
"The peaches in this garden are not like peaches on Earth," said the gardener.
"These peaches take thousands of years to become ripe. Anybody who takes a bite of one will live forever."

assistant_review.rationale: 园丁明确说明仙桃要数千年才成熟；三百年是悟空当时年龄相关信息，“永远”是吃桃后的寿命效果而非成熟时间。

questions.q: which is not true?
choices: it was time for the peach festival.
wukong ate all of the peaches.

answer_evidence.quote: It was almost time for the annual Peach Festival.
"The Peach Festival is tomorrow," said the queen.
"I ate them," said Wukong.
"I ate every single one! And they were delicious!"
"No, you're not going to tell the queen," said Wukong.
He quickly said a spell.
Instantly Red Gown and Blue Gown fell asleep.

assistant_review.rationale: 蟠桃会确实临近，悟空也亲口承认吃光每一颗桃；他反而施法让两名仙女睡着后离开，并未被她们抓住，所以 A 是不正确项。

questions.q: why did the maidens gasp at the garden?
questions.q_zh: 少女们为什么在花园里倒吸一口凉气？

answer_evidence.quote: Red Gown and Blue Gown went to the garden.
As soon as they went through the gate, both maidens gasped.
"Where are all the peaches?" cried Red Gown.
"They're . . . gone!" cried Blue Gown.

assistant_review.rationale: 两名仙女一进桃园便因桃子全部消失而惊呼；原文没有说她们因花园美丽或树木高大而惊讶。

questions.q: who was angry at wukong?

answer_evidence.quote: "The queen will be angry!"

questions.q: who was guanyin?

answer_evidence.quote: "All the important gods and spirits in Heaven will be here. I also invited the bodhisattva Guanyin, the goddess of mercy. Go to the Peach Garden now, and pick plenty of ripe peaches."

questions.q: what happened to the emperor's army?
questions.q_zh: 皇帝的军队发生了什么事？
choices_zh: 他们吃光了所有的桃子。

answer_evidence.quote: "Gather 100,000 soldiers. I want Wukong arrested!"
"I sent 100,000 soldiers to arrest him. They'll bring him back to Heaven soon."
Just then a messenger ran into the court.
"We need more soldiers, Your Majesty!"
"Wukong defeated the entire army," said the messenger.

assistant_review.rationale: 玉帝派出十万天兵，信使随后明确报告悟空打败整支军队；军队没有逮捕成功，吃光桃子的是悟空而非军队。

questions.q: why was wukong happy?

answer_evidence.quote: "Our king has just defeated an entire army from Heaven!" said the gibbon.

assistant_review.rationale: 花果山群猴庆祝的是悟空刚击败天兵；吃桃发生在此前，旗杆只是后来寺庙变身的一部分，并非他高兴的原因。

questions.q: who was sent to arrest wukong?

answer_evidence.quote: "Perhaps we can ask the sage Erlang to capture him," said Guanyin.
"The Jade Emperor sent me to arrest you."

assistant_review.rationale: 观音建议请二郎神，玉帝随后派二郎神逮捕悟空；观音没有亲自奉命逮捕，老子只是后来用金属环协助。

questions.q: what did wukong not turn into?

answer_evidence.quote: He turned himself into a fish and swam in the water.
"I'll turn myself into a temple," he thought.

assistant_review.rationale: 原文明确悟空变成鱼和寺庙，还变过麻雀，但本集没有变成老虎，因此 A 是未变成的形态。

questions.q: how long did the fight last?

answer_evidence.quote: Their weapons banged together all through the night.
They were still fighting when the sun rose the next morning.

assistant_review.rationale: 战斗持续整夜并延续到第二天早晨，显然不是不到一小时；原文也没有持续一周，三项中只有 A 符合这场跨日战斗。

questions.q: what hit wukong on the head?
questions.q_zh: 是什么打到了悟空的头？

answer_evidence.quote: Clunk! The ring hit Wukong on the head.

questions.q: who did not attack wukong?

answer_evidence.quote: Several fire gods entered the courtyard and threw balls of flame at Wukong.
The Jade Emperor smiled as lightning bolts shot toward Wukong.

assistant_review.rationale: 火神用火球、雷神用闪电攻击悟空；佛祖本集只是前来质问，没有发动攻击，所以 A 是未攻击者。

questions.q: why couldn't wukong be harmed?

answer_evidence.quote: "That's because he ate all the peaches," said Laozi.
"Just one peach would make someone live forever. He ate every peach in the garden!"

assistant_review.rationale: 老子明确说悟空吃光仙桃因而不灭；并非佛祖保护，也不是二郎神赋予力量。

questions.q: what was laozi's idea?
choices: to burn wukong in a pot

answer_evidence.quote: "I have an idea," said Laozi.
"I'll put him in the large pot I use for making potions. Maybe we can burn him up slowly."

assistant_review.rationale: 老子的方案是把悟空放进炼药大锅慢慢烧；不是在锅外投火球，也不是用剑砍。

questions.q: where was wukong causing trouble?

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong smiled. "I am Sun Wukong, king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I should be the king of Heaven too! I'm going to the Cloud Palace to tell the Jade Emperor to leave. If he doesn't, I'll never stop causing trouble!"

questions.q: what did wukong tell buddha?
choices: he wanted to be king of heaven.
he wanted to return to the mountain.
he wanted to go to the western paradise.

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong smiled. "I am Sun Wukong, king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I should be the king of Heaven too! I'm going to the Cloud Palace to tell the Jade Emperor to leave. If he doesn't, I'll never stop causing trouble!"

assistant_review.rationale: 悟空亲口说自己也应成为天庭之王；他没有说想回花果山，也没有说想去西天。

questions.q: what was the bet?
